title: Which frame does the thumbnail filter pick?
fullTitle: FFmpeg thumbnail Picks Frame 54 of 100, Not the Most Detailed Frame 80

scenes.narration: The thumbnail filter promises the most representative frame. Which frame is that, and is it the best one? We build a hundred frame clip, a dark title card then a colourful scene, and measure the pick four ways.
captions: Is it the best one? Measured four ways.

scenes.narration: Fifty five frames of dark title card with a growing loading bar, then forty five frames of colour bars. Every frame is different. Readers: f f m peg timestamps and hashes, raw pixels in Node, and the filter's algorithm, rewritten.
captions: Frames 0 to 54: title card. Frames 55 to 99: scene.
Readers: ffmpeg pts and framemd5, raw pixels, the algorithm.

scenes.narration: Controls first. A ramp of ninety nine frames has its average at frame forty nine, and thumbnail picks forty nine. A hundred frames with one white odd frame: it never picks the odd one, it picks frame zero. All four readers agree.
captions: Ramp of 99 frames: picks 49, the middle.
100 frames, one odd frame 37: picks 0, never 37.

scenes.narration: With default settings it picks frame fifty four, the last of the title card. Mean luma thirty nine, against a hundred and fourteen for frame eighty, the most detailed. Fifty four has a tenth of the entropy: rank forty six of a hundred.
captions: Default: frame 54, the dark title card.
Entropy 0.44 bits vs 4.55 for frame 80. Rank 46 of 100.

scenes.narration: It picks one frame per batch of n. Fifty: frames twenty four and ninety three. Twenty five: four frames. Ten: ten frames. A sixty frame clip still gets one. Where the batches fall decides the answer.
captions: n=10 gives ten frames. A 60 frame clip gives one.

scenes.narration: To get a scene frame, make the batch the scene: trim from frame fifty five, then thumbnail forty five. It picks seventy four: entropy ninety eight percent of the best, rank thirty two. Most typical, still not the best.
captions: trim from frame 55, thumbnail n=45: frame 74.
Entropy 98% of the best frame. Rank 32 of 100.

scenes.narration: So thumbnail picks the frame closest to the average colour histogram of its batch: the most typical frame, not the best. Choose the batch yourself and check the pick. Not tested: real footage, other pixel formats, other builds.
captions: Closest to the batch average, not the best.
Not tested: real footage, other pixel formats, other builds.
